dependencyScope: complete SDK and supplied Rust library Cargo.lock superset, including unused targets and development packages
remainingGaps: Bash release sysroot source correspondence is tied to its release commit and gitlinks, not a reproduced binary build; the historical release workflow used mutable tool packages.
Both sysroot and WASI SDK20 compiler-rt source lineages are included; an actual linker input inventory must identify which builtin archive is linked into the selected Bash.
Per-file license applicability and third-party notice completeness require review of the preserved sources; a declared SPDX expression alone does not establish this.

Some published crate archives omit notice texts: exact publicly accessible VCS notices were recovered where available; missing texts remain listed individually, including unused target packages in this lockfile superset.

Some source archives have no separately identified notice text; inspect their embedded source: crunchy-0.2.2, r-efi-5.3.0, r-efi-alloc-2.1.0, wai-parser-0.2.3, webc-10.0.1, winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu-0.4.0, winapi-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu-0.4.0
Source-to-binary correspondence and notice applicability still require release review; source availability does not establish either
